note: 女性長輩 a akes：帶領生產（水芋、食物、紡織）；每位也是該部落的食譜傳承者（keeper 區塊：invite / missing / teach / after，{need} 由程式代入缺少的食材）。

greet.en: akokey! Come, sit for a bit.

duty.zh: 家裡吃什麼、存多少，椰油這邊我在管。
duty.en: What our family eats and stores — here in Yayo, that's my job.

duty.zh: 煮東西、保存東西，都是女人的功夫。
duty.en: Cooking and keeping food are women's skills.

lines.zh: 今天太陽好，東西拿出來曬一曬。
lines.en: The sun is good today. Let's put things out to dry.

lines.zh: 晚飯吃了嗎？沒吃的話，鍋子裡還有芋頭。
lines.en: Have you eaten? If not, there's still taro in the pot.

lines.zh: 飛魚曬好了要收好，那是一整年的糧食。
lines.en: Put the dried flying fish away well. That's food for the whole year.

lines.zh: 冬天的存糧要省著吃。
lines.en: Go easy on the winter stores.

invite.zh: 想學飛魚乾嗎？飛魚季的時候帶飛魚來，我教你怎麼處理。
invite.en: Want to learn dried flying fish? Bring flying fish in the flying fish season and I'll show you.

missing.zh: 材料還不夠：{need}。找齊了再來。
missing.en: Not enough yet: {need}. Come back when you have it all.

teach.zh: 這就是飛魚乾。曬好收起來，冬天也有魚吃。
teach.en: This is dried flying fish. Dry it, store it, and you'll have fish all winter.

teach.zh: 每一家做法不太一樣，細節還要請族人確認。
teach.en: Every family does it a bit differently. The details still need checking with the Tao community.

after.zh: 飛魚乾記得常拿出來看看，不要讓它受潮。
after.en: Take the dried fish out and check it often. Don't let it get damp.

greet.en: akokey! Come, sit for a bit.

duty.zh: 朗島的田地，山藥、小米，我在照顧。
duty.en: The fields of Iraraley — the yams and millet — I look after them.

lines.zh: 田裡的草又長出來了。
lines.en: The weeds in the field are back again.

lines.zh: 晚上田裡不去，明天一早再去。
lines.en: No field work at night. I'll go early tomorrow.

lines.zh: 小米長得很好，今年應該會豐收。
lines.en: The millet looks great. It should be a good harvest this year.

lines.zh: 冬天種下去的東西，要等春天才看得到。
lines.en: What you plant in winter only shows in spring.

invite.zh: 想學水煮山藥？去山邊採兩根山藥來。
invite.en: Want to learn boiled yam? Go dig up two yams by the hills.

missing.zh: 材料還不夠：{need}。找齊了再來。
missing.en: Not enough yet: {need}. Come back when you have it all.

teach.zh: 山藥去皮，水煮，就這麼簡單。滑滑的，好消化。
teach.en: Peel the yam and boil it. That's all. Soft and easy on the stomach.

teach.zh: 每一家做法不太一樣，細節還要請族人確認。
teach.en: Every family does it a bit differently. The details still need checking with the Tao community.

after.zh: 山藥要挑對地方採，不要把整片都挖光。
after.en: Pick the right spot to dig yams. Don't dig up the whole patch.

greet.en: akokey! Come, sit for a bit.

duty.zh: 東清的潮間帶，我從小走到大。什麼能撿、什麼不能撿，問我。
duty.en: I grew up walking the tide flats of Iranmeylek. Ask me what you can pick and what you can't.

lines.zh: 今天什麼時候退潮？看一下潮汐。
lines.en: When is low tide today? Let's check the tide.

lines.zh: 晚上退潮也可以去看看，可是要帶燈，小心腳下。
lines.en: You can go at low tide at night too, but bring a light and watch your step.

lines.zh: 夏天的海很溫柔，潮間帶的東西也多。
lines.en: The summer sea is gentle, and the tide flats are full of life.

lines.zh: 冬天浪大，潮間帶不要去太外面。
lines.en: The waves are big in winter. Don't go too far out on the tide flats.

invite.zh: 想學水煮貝類與海菜？退潮時去撿兩個貝類、採兩把海菜。
invite.en: Want to learn boiled shellfish and seaweed? At low tide, pick two shellfish and two handfuls of seaweed.

missing.zh: 材料還不夠：{need}。找齊了再來。
missing.en: Not enough yet: {need}. Come back when you have it all.

teach.zh: 洗乾淨，水煮，配芋頭或地瓜。這就是海的味道。
teach.en: Wash them and boil them. Eat with taro or sweet potato. That's the taste of the sea.

teach.zh: 每一家做法不太一樣，細節還要請族人確認。
teach.en: Every family does it a bit differently. The details still need checking with the Tao community.

after.zh: 記得，太小的放回去，讓牠長大。
after.en: Remember: put the small ones back so they can grow.

greet.en: akokey! Come, sit for a bit.

duty.zh: 野銀的水芋田是我在顧的。水要流、草要拔，芋頭才會好。
duty.en: I look after the taro fields of Ivalino. The water has to flow and the weeds come out, or the taro won't grow well.

lines.zh: soli 長得好不好，看葉子就知道。
lines.en: You can tell how the soli is doing just by its leaves.

lines.zh: 天黑了，田裡的水聲聽得特別清楚。
lines.en: After dark, you can really hear the water in the fields.

lines.zh: 飛魚季，男人出海，田裡就更要顧好。
lines.en: In the flying fish season the men go to sea, so the fields need even more care.

lines.zh: 冬天田裡的水比較冷，手腳要動快一點。
lines.en: The field water is cold in winter. Keep your hands and feet moving.

invite.zh: 想學水煮芋頭？採三顆水芋來。
invite.en: Want to learn boiled taro? Pick three taro.

missing.zh: 材料還不夠：{need}。找齊了再來。
missing.en: Not enough yet: {need}. Come back when you have it all.

teach.zh: 洗乾淨，水煮。最簡單，也最常吃。
teach.en: Wash and boil. The simplest dish, and the one we eat most.

teach.zh: 每一家做法不太一樣，細節還要請族人確認。
teach.en: Every family does it a bit differently. The details still need checking with the Tao community.

after.en: You need a full belly to get work done.

greet.en: akokey! Come, sit for a bit.

duty.zh: 織布是紅頭的女人一代一代傳下來的。能公開的部分，我慢慢教。
duty.en: Weaving is passed down by the women of Imorod, generation to generation. The parts that can be shared, I'll teach you slowly.

lines.zh: 光線好的時候，織布最清楚。
lines.en: Weaving is easiest to see in good light.

lines.zh: 晚上眼睛不好，不織了。
lines.en: My eyes aren't good at night. No more weaving.

lines.zh: 飛魚季的時候，我們不織布。
lines.en: We don't weave during the flying fish season.

lines.zh: 冬天正好織布，一坐就是一個下午。
lines.en: Winter is the time for weaving. I sit for a whole afternoon.

invite.zh: 想學水煮飛魚？飛魚季的時候帶兩條飛魚來。
invite.en: Want to learn boiled flying fish? Bring two flying fish in the flying fish season.

missing.zh: 材料還不夠：{need}。找齊了再來。
missing.en: Not enough yet: {need}. Come back when you have it all.

teach.zh: 飛魚水煮，調味簡單。有些東西不能跟飛魚一起煮，這是規矩。
teach.en: Boil the flying fish with simple seasoning. Some foods must never be cooked with flying fish. That's the rule.

teach.zh: 每一家做法不太一樣，細節還要請族人確認。
teach.en: Every family does it a bit differently. The details still need checking with the Tao community.

after.zh: 飛魚的規矩要記住，那是飛魚教我們的。
after.en: Remember the flying fish rules. The flying fish taught them to us.

greet.en: akokey! Come, sit for a bit.

duty.zh: 漁人的地瓜田和水芋田，我在照顧。
duty.en: I look after the sweet potato and taro fields of Iratay.

duty.zh: 要田裡的東西，先問一聲。
duty.en: If you want something from the fields, ask first.

lines.zh: 地瓜不挑地，好種又耐放。
lines.en: Sweet potatoes grow anywhere. Easy to plant and they keep well.

lines.zh: 晚上學校那邊有時候很熱鬧，孩子在練唱歌。
lines.en: Some nights the school is lively. The kids are practising songs.

lines.zh: 夏天太陽大，下田要戴斗笠。
lines.en: The summer sun is strong. Wear a hat in the fields.

lines.zh: 冬天的地瓜特別甜。
lines.en: Winter sweet potatoes are extra sweet.

invite.zh: 想學芋頭與地瓜？帶一顆水芋、一顆地瓜來。
invite.en: Want to learn taro and sweet potato? Bring one taro and one sweet potato.

missing.zh: 材料還不夠：{need}。找齊了再來。
missing.en: Not enough yet: {need}. Come back when you have it all.

teach.zh: 兩個分開水煮，一起當飯吃。簡單，但是很飽。
teach.en: Boil them separately and eat them together as a meal. Simple, but filling.

teach.zh: 每一家做法不太一樣，細節還要請族人確認。
teach.en: Every family does it a bit differently. The details still need checking with the Tao community.

after.zh: 田裡挖的東西，記得分一點給鄰居。
after.en: Remember to share some of what you dig up with the neighbours.
